answer: The voyage register is checked at draw time, falcon lists the eligible set, and vine seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 87 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 87 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
